title: Harbor Courier
tagline: Zip bright seaside streets, grab the parcels, and beat the harbor clock.
pitch: Harbor Courier is a compact top-down delivery sprint through a sunny coastal town. Ride a nimble little scooter from parcel crate to color-coded doorstep, choosing between short narrow lanes and longer open streets while the countdown drains. Each handoff turns the town map into the next clear route puzzle.
coreLoop: Drive onto the glowing parcel crate to load it, follow the large color-and-icon destination marker through streets blocked by buildings, gardens, docks, and water, then enter the matching delivery circle to hand it off. Repeat three deliveries before the clock reaches zero.

mechanics.name: Scooter handling
mechanics.description: Arrow keys or WASD drive a small top-down scooter with quick acceleration, gentle momentum, and responsive steering. The scooter cannot pass through buildings, planter walls, dock barriers, or water.

mechanics.name: Parcel-to-doorstep chain
mechanics.description: A parcel crate is always placed at a reachable street-side loading point. Collecting it updates the HUD and activates one of three named, color-coded destination circles: Marina Cafe, Lighthouse House, and Market Pier.

mechanics.name: Meaningful harbor routes
mechanics.description: The fixed single-screen town uses blocky building blocks, water inlets, and dock fences to create two or more routes between loading points and destinations. Narrow shortcuts save time but demand cleaner turns; broad streets are safer but longer.

mechanics.name: Three-stop delivery run
mechanics.description: A run requires three sequential parcel collections and deliveries to three distinct named destinations. After every delivery, a new crate and target are immediately highlighted with a world arrow and HUD instruction.

mechanics.name: Countdown pressure
mechanics.description: The run begins with 70 seconds. The visible timer pulses amber below 15 seconds and red below 7 seconds; zero time ends an unfinished run in a clear Late Delivery failure screen.

mechanics.name: Friendly route assist
mechanics.description: A large edge-of-screen arrow points toward the active crate or destination, while wide loading and delivery circles make the arcade task fair under keyboard control without reducing obstacle-based route choice.

mechanics.name: Fresh-run restart
mechanics.description: Success and failure screens show PRESS SPACE TO RIDE AGAIN. Space resets timer, score, parcel chain, scooter position, and destination state without a page reload.

controls.keyboard: WASD or Arrow Keys drive; Space starts from the title and starts a fresh run after a result.
controls.mouse: Mouse is optional; hover over the title start button and click to begin or restart.

artDirection.backgroundFx: Animated turquoise water ripples and bobbing boat silhouettes form a slow rear parallax layer; drifting gull specks and tiny sun-glints move above it behind the town streets.

audioDirection.musicMood: breezy hand-percussion and cheerful marimba-like synth loop
sfx: soft scooter engine hum that rises with speed
gentle descending whistle on late delivery

difficulty.start: The first crate is beside the spawn and the Marina Cafe is reached by a broad, clearly marked street.
difficulty.progression: The second and third legs introduce a water inlet and building blocks that make the shortcut-versus-safe-road decision more relevant, while destinations remain large and clearly signposted.
difficulty.peak: The final Market Pier delivery asks for a clean dock-side turn under the late-clock pulse, but has generous delivery radius and no hostile pressure.

winLose.win: Deliver all three parcels before the countdown expires; show a full-screen "ALL DELIVERIES MADE!" result with final score and restart prompt.
winLose.lose: If the countdown reaches 0 with fewer than three deliveries, freeze play and show a full-screen "TOO LATE — HARBOR CLOSED" result with restart prompt.

juice.screenShake: A restrained 4px, 0.16-second bump occurs when the scooter clips a solid obstacle; a 6px, 0.24-second celebration shake occurs on the third delivery.
juice.particles: Parcel pickup emits paper-confetti squares; each doorstep handoff releases colored receipt sparks and a brief gull-feather burst; scooter tires emit sparse pale dust on fast turns.
juice.hitStop: A 70ms pause punctuates each successful delivery, especially the final handoff.
juice.flash: A warm destination-color flash at alpha 0.35 accompanies a delivery, while a soft blue-white flash at alpha 0.25 marks parcel loading.

scopeNotes: Do not build combat, enemies, weapons, attacks, health, damage, bosses, robots, crafting, salvage, forging, upgrades, inventory management, traffic AI, procedural maps, scrolling levels, multiplayer, meta-progression, or a cyberpunk, military, or heavy-industrial aesthetic. Keep one fixed 960x540 town, three mandatory deliveries, and obstacle navigation as the entire game.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: During active play, a player-controlled courier scooter movement transition is emitted after gameplay score progress.
A completed delivery transition records a delivery to one of the three distinct named destinations after a parcel has been collected.
Attempting to drive the scooter into a solid environment obstacle increases the real obstacle contact count.
An unfinished run whose countdown reaches zero reaches the clear failed state.
Collecting a parcel updates the active delivery target during gameplay.
Completing the required three deliveries before expiry reaches the clear success state.
Pressing Space from either result screen starts a reset fresh run in the playing state.
During active scored gameplay, the timer, score/progress, and current target HUD regions are distinct, readable, in bounds, and non-overlapping.
No combat action event occurs during the complete observed play session.
No boss encounter event occurs during the complete observed play session.
No crafting or upgrade loop event occurs during the complete observed play session.
No cyberpunk or military visual-mode event occurs during the complete observed play session.

scoreEvents: parcel_collected adds 100 score when the scooter enters an active parcel crate radius
delivery_completed adds 500 score when a carried parcel enters its matching destination circle

The deterministic verifier path starts with Space, reaches the nearby first parcel, follows the persistent target arrow using directional input, and earns score through parcel collection and delivery; if it remains unfinished, the 70-second countdown deterministically reaches failed.

scenarios.purpose: prove real successful completion under deterministic active input
